title: FX-200 Laser Cutter
subtitle: Model FX-200 · Serial FX200-0042 · Workshop 2 (demo machine)
summary: A CO2 laser cutter used for cutting and engraving sheet material. This is a fictional demonstration page showing how a QX opens a machine.

sections.title: Safety
items: Never open the lid while a job is running.
Wear laser safety glasses when servicing with the lid open.
Keep a fire extinguisher within reach of the machine.
Do not cut PVC or vinyl: it releases toxic gas.

sections.title: Daily checks
items: Switch on the exhaust fan before cutting.
Check that the air-assist pump is running.
Wipe the lens and mirrors with lens tissue only.

sections.title: Maintenance schedule
rows: Use lens tissue and the approved cleaner

sections.title: Troubleshooting
rows: Cuts do not go all the way through
Twist the red button to release it
Check the coolant level and pump, then restart

documents.title: Operating guide
documents.text:
Switch on the exhaust fan first, then the machine. Wait for the display to show Ready before loading a job.

Place the material flat on the bed and set the focus using the gauge. Close the lid before starting.

At the end of the day, switch off the machine first and the exhaust fan last, and remove all offcuts from the bed.

faqs.a: Only people who have completed the workshop induction. Ask the workshop supervisor if you are unsure.
